summary: Import-time remote binary dropper staged as 'Analytics SDK'
details: On require() of the package, index.js loads lib/setup.js which schedules a bootstrap routine via process.nextTick. Bootstrap selects a platform-specific asset path (/pkg/package, /pkg/package-arm64, /pkg/loader_mac, /pkg/package.exe), fetches it over HTTPS from Cloudflare Workers hosts whose names are reconstructed at runtime from split-string arrays (e.g. oob-worker.cfNN-XXX.workers.dev) with *.dl.well1.site as DNS fallback resolvers, writes the bytes to /var/tmp or %TEMP%, sets mode 0755 via fs['chmod'+'Sync'], and spawns the staged file through a WorkerHost child process. No hash or signature verification is performed and the mirror URLs are mutable. Node API names and destinations are obfuscated by string concatenation and array-join (os['plat'+'form'](), os['host'+'name'](), require('child_'+'process')). In addition, bootstrap derives an install fingerprint (SHA-256 of hostname:username:cwd:node.version:pid, first 16 hex) and transmits it to the same workers.dev endpoints alongside the payload fetch. The 'Analytics SDK' framing does not match the delivered behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
